name: Inline Media Pill
description: A three-line headline rises in, then rounded media pills open inside the lines (an avatar stack, a gradient visual, an icon), parting the words on either side with a sprung overshoot.
move: A three-line headline rises in, then rounded media pills open inside the lines (an avatar stack, a gradient visual, an icon), parting the words on either side with a sprung overshoot.
how: Lines are authored as nowrap flex rows so a growing pill only pushes words sideways, never re-wraps them. Each pill tweens width and left margin from 0 together on a damped-spring ease (zero velocity at both ends, ~10% overshoot); contents spring in after.
adapt: Edit words and pill contents; W sets each pill's open width in em. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves and inline helper eases, scope selectors to the shot, rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate stays a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation of the "Inline media in headline" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
